**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant. Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce" and "employees" surface only:

- **§ 13 (Shared Resources)** — Commerce One must provide Corio access to its operations, consulting and engineering personnel, and warrants those personnel are under Employee NDA/Invention Agreements. No hiring restriction on Corio.
- **§ 14.5 (Independent Contractors)** — status clause only.
- **§ 14.10 (Complete Understanding)** — integrates only the NDA and Statement of Work, so no non-solicit is pulled in by reference.

This is the playbook's **preferred** position (no non-solicit binding the Customer), so nothing is flagged.
